name: @gosleep/runner-adapter
description: Thin adapter over the Claude Code CLI (`claude agents --json`) — the ONLY place the harness process shells to `claude`. Kept out of apps/core so a future runner (a different local agent host, a remote SessionAdapter per rev-3 addendum Delta 10) can be dropped in without touching the control-plane routes. Used by apps/core/src/workers/fleet-poll.ts to project per-agent state into the `agent_sessions` table (GSL-276).
